entities.name: The Tangle
entities.description: A huge expanse of copper structures on Mirrodin that was the closest thing to a forest, center of Sylvok and Viridian elf cultures.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane on which the Tangle lies.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Invaders who infected the Tangle with lamina and built nine layers on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Viridian elves
entities.description: Elves who dwell in the Tangle's metal spires and send their dead to the Radix.

entities.name: Trolls
entities.description: Keepers of Tel-Jilad who guide the elves.

entities.name: The Radix
entities.description: A sacred copper clearing where the elves send their dead and banish unnatural devices.

entities.name: Tel-Jilad
entities.description: The largest tree, home of the elves and trolls.

entities.name: Lord Araneas
entities.description: Honored by the Sylvok with the Araneas Altar.

entities.name: Lyese
entities.description: A light that shone above the Tangle after it appeared.

events.summary: With Phyrexia's advance, the Tangle is infected by lamina fungus, rotting the ground.
events.quote: the Tangle was infected by the growth of lamina

events.summary: After the Phyrexians build nine layers on Mirrodin, the Tangle is transplanted to the fourth layer as the Hunter's Maze.
events.quote: the Tangle was transplanted to the fourth layer, becoming the Hunter's Maze

relations.note: They made dwellings in the tree-like spires.
relations.quote: The elves made their dwellings in the tree-like metal spires here

relations.note: Trolls guide the elves as keepers of Tel-Jilad.
relations.quote: under the guidance of the trolls
